purpose: hp/diagnostics.sh sets HP_COMMAND_MODE=diagnose; hp/repair.sh sets repair

actions.intent: Execute every owning local source, domain, compile and quality gate; no live app/device acceptance.
actions.recovery: Fix the failed owner or missing pinned tool/cache and repeat the complete forced gate; failed/skipped checks are inconclusive.

actions.intent: Read-only device queries and local CUPS reads; --plain stable key=value; repair flags rejected. Read-only still sends device/LAN packets.
actions.recovery: Retain missing endpoint evidence and unavailable queue; verify intended host before retry.

printer_host.description: Explicit operator-selected input; supplied as one argv value.

actions.intent: Help by default. Not an alias for auto repair.
actions.recovery: Choose explicitly scoped repair only after reviewing help/host; no repair implied by help.

actions.intent: Full repair recipe may soft reset, clear device job list and disable/cancel ePrint connectivity. Saves captures; --fix alias same effect. No action executed in this pass.

requires.reason: writable evidence directory and transport tools

actions.recovery: Inspect pre/post endpoint/job evidence; stopped partial recipe is not rollback; do not blindly repeat device reset.

printer_host.description: Explicit operator-selected input; supplied as one argv value.

actions.intent: Exact tests diagnostics rejects repair actions after the split; repair help is the default; repair execute and fix aliases run the full repair recipe; spool note needs processing jobs on both IPP and the HP job list. Mock transports, no live printer.
actions.recovery: Fix exact command-mode or interpretation regression and rerun all suites.

learning.summary: Printer observations must cross-check IPP and HP job list before diagnosing spool pressure; diagnostics cannot accept repair flags, while repair requires explicit --execute/--fix.
when: When changing transport interpretation, script dispatch or repair grammar.
